text: A simple digital platform for members, contributions, financing, repayments, reports, and approvals.
textPreview: A simple digital platform for members, contributions, financing, repayments, reports, and approvals.

text: Introduce Halaalvest as a practical operations system for cooperatives. Keep the opening focused on everyday cooperative work: members, savings, contributions, approvals, repayments, and reports.
Cooperative teams often carry critical records across too many places.
textPreview: Cooperative teams often carry critical records across too many places.

text: Manual work creates avoidable blind spots.
textPreview: Manual work creates avoidable blind spots.

text: Spreadsheets, paper files, and manual reconciliation slow down reporting.
textPreview: Spreadsheets, paper files, and manual reconciliation slow down reporting.

text: Member balances and repayment positions can be hard to explain quickly.
textPreview: Member balances and repayment positions can be hard to explain quickly.

text: Approvals, follow-ups, and audit history become difficult to track.
textPreview: Approvals, follow-ups, and audit history become difficult to track.

text: Emphasize pain points without sounding like blame. The goal is to show why a shared system matters: faster reporting, clearer balances, better follow-up, and stronger member trust.
One operational source of truth for the cooperative.
textPreview: One operational source of truth for the cooperative.

text: Approvals, reports, roles, and audit history
textPreview: Approvals, reports, roles, and audit history

text: Position the platform as the central workspace for daily cooperative operations. The key message is not technology for its own sake; it is operational clarity.
Each role gets access based on responsibility.
textPreview: Each role gets access based on responsibility.

text: Account history and self-service when enabled
textPreview: Account history and self-service when enabled

text: Explain that the system is role-based. Admins do not need every staff member to see or change everything; access can follow actual responsibilities.
The setup path turns a new workspace into a usable cooperative system.
textPreview: The setup path turns a new workspace into a usable cooperative system.

text: Show that new cooperatives are guided through setup instead of left to guess. Mention profile, start date, charges, contribution rules, share settings, financing rules, staff roles, and member onboarding.
Every cooperative can have a direct workspace link.
textPreview: Every cooperative can have a direct workspace link.

text: A dedicated subdomain makes the platform easier to access and easier to share with staff and members.
textPreview: A dedicated subdomain makes the platform easier to access and easier to share with staff and members.

text: A dedicated subdomain makes the platform easier to access and easier to share with staff and members.
textPreview: A dedicated subdomain makes the platform easier to access and easier to share with staff and members.

text: Explain that each cooperative can have its own access link. This makes the workspace feel more organized and reduces confusion when staff or members need to sign in.
A branded domain can make the member experience feel more trusted.
textPreview: A branded domain can make the member experience feel more trusted.

text: Established cooperatives can later connect their own domain for a more familiar member portal.
textPreview: Established cooperatives can later connect their own domain for a more familiar member portal.

text: Established cooperatives can later connect their own domain for a more familiar member portal.
textPreview: Established cooperatives can later connect their own domain for a more familiar member portal.

text: Present this as a future branding and trust feature. Cooperatives that already have a website or official domain can eventually bring the member portal under their own trusted address.
Existing cooperatives do not need to start from zero.
textPreview: Existing cooperatives do not need to start from zero.

text: Old records can be brought into the platform so the cooperative continues from its real current position.
textPreview: Old records can be brought into the platform so the cooperative continues from its real current position.

text: Make clear that existing cooperatives can migrate old records. Mention member lists, savings balances, contributions, repayments, charges, levies, financing history, and share or profit history where available.
Historical records are checked before they become live finance records.
textPreview: Historical records are checked before they become live finance records.

text: This slide is about trust. Imported history should be staged first, reviewed by staff, corrected where needed, then applied into the live system. This protects accuracy and avoids silent mistakes.
A clean member record is the foundation of the cooperative database.
textPreview: A clean member record is the foundation of the cooperative database.

text: Staff can register members, manage categories, track status, review KYC or documents, and view account history.
textPreview: Staff can register members, manage categories, track status, review KYC or documents, and view account history.

text: Present member management as the foundation. Once member records are clean, contributions, financing, repayments, reports, and member statements become easier to manage.
Finance teams can see what is expected, paid, and outstanding.
textPreview: Finance teams can see what is expected, paid, and outstanding.

text: The platform tracks expected contributions, received payments, unpaid members, savings balances, and payment channels.
textPreview: The platform tracks expected contributions, received payments, unpaid members, savings balances, and payment channels.

text: Highlight that finance officers can quickly see what has been paid and what is outstanding. This supports liquidity planning and member follow-up.
Financing is managed from request to repayment with clear policy checks.
textPreview: Financing is managed from request to repayment with clear policy checks.

text: Members request financing, and admins approve based on policy, savings, eligibility, and available cooperative funds.
textPreview: Members request financing, and admins approve based on policy, savings, eligibility, and available cooperative funds.

text: Avoid interest-based language. Emphasize cooperative pool deployment, eligibility, available funds, approval history, disbursement tracking, and transparent repayment.
Every charge and repayment stays clear and traceable.
textPreview: Every charge and repayment stays clear and traceable.

text: Cooperatives can manage levies, service charges, repayment schedules, waivers, adjustments, and overdue follow-ups.
textPreview: Cooperatives can manage levies, service charges, repayment schedules, waivers, adjustments, and overdue follow-ups.

text: Explain that fees, charges, and levies should be explicit and policy-backed. The system should make it clear why a member was charged and how repayments were recorded.
The dashboard answers the daily question: what needs attention now?
textPreview: The dashboard answers the daily question: what needs attention now?

text: Deployable funds after holds and commitments
textPreview: Deployable funds after holds and commitments

text: Approvals, KYC reviews, imports, setup warnings
textPreview: Approvals, KYC reviews, imports, setup warnings

text: The dashboard should be exception-led. It should help admins see deployable funds, collection coverage, overdue repayments, pending approvals, KYC reviews, failed imports, and setup warnings.
The platform supports member statements, contribution summaries, repayment reports, finance summaries, approval history, and audit records.
textPreview: The platform supports member statements, contribution summaries, repayment reports, finance summaries, approval history, and audit records.

text: Tie reporting to accountability. The cooperative should be able to explain member balances, repayments, approvals, charges, and historical records.
The live demo follows one complete cooperative workflow.
textPreview: The live demo follows one complete cooperative workflow.

text: Use this as the live flow. It keeps the presentation focused and makes the product easier to understand because the audience can follow one story from setup to report.
Early cooperatives can use the platform free during beta.
textPreview: Early cooperatives can use the platform free during beta.

text: Beta users help shape the final product through real workflow feedback before paid subscription begins.
textPreview: Beta users help shape the final product through real workflow feedback before paid subscription begins.

text: Say clearly that beta is free until official release. Also clarify that beta is a market-entry period, not a permanent free live-finance tier.
Pricing is designed to be predictable for cooperative budgets.
textPreview: Pricing is designed to be predictable for cooperative budgets.

text: After release, pricing will depend on cooperative size, feature needs, support level, and optional add-ons.
textPreview: After release, pricing will depend on cooperative size, feature needs, support level, and optional add-ons.

text: Provider costs kept separate where applicable
textPreview: Provider costs kept separate where applicable

text: Emphasize predictable subscription pricing. The platform should not take a percentage of member savings, financing, repayments, dividends, or cooperative profit.
Plans can be finalized after member size, migration needs, and support expectations are known.
textPreview: Plans can be finalized after member size, migration needs, and support expectations are known.

text: Core workflows while beta is active
textPreview: Core workflows while beta is active

text: Setup and historical migration may be separate when data is complex.
textPreview: Setup and historical migration may be separate when data is complex.

text: Keep the pricing flexible. Mention that setup and historical data migration may be a one-time service depending on data size and complexity.
The platform will keep improving around real cooperative work.
textPreview: The platform will keep improving around real cooperative work.

text: Updates will be shaped by staff feedback, member needs, reporting gaps, and workflows observed during beta and live use.
textPreview: Updates will be shaped by staff feedback, member needs, reporting gaps, and workflows observed during beta and live use.

text: This reassures the audience that the product will evolve with their operations. Use this to invite honest feedback during the beta period.
The roadmap focuses on communication, intelligence, mobility, and trust.
textPreview: The roadmap focuses on communication, intelligence, mobility, and trust.

text: Present these as features in the pipeline. Avoid promising that all of them are available today. Call out WhatsApp notifications, AI assistance, mobile app, automated reminders, member self-service, integrations, and personalized domains.
Start with a pilot, validate the data, gather feedback, then agree the launch and subscription path.
textPreview: Start with a pilot, validate the data, gather feedback, then agree the launch and subscription path.

text: Close with a clear path forward: pilot setup, sample data entry, historical data review, staff demo, feedback collection, beta usage, and final subscription discussion after official release.
